# Prakash Adhikari — AI Product Builder

> Intelligent portfolio: products, knowledge base, guided journeys, and proof.
> Kathmandu, Nepal · Contact: /contact.html · hello@prakashadhikari.dev

## Who

AI product builder who ships LegalTech, EdTech, and edge-native SaaS, and documents
research, patterns, decisions, and founder notes so visitors (and agents) can understand
how he thinks and how to collaborate.

## Current projects / focus

- Building: AI workflow systems (see /now.html, /roadmap.html)
- Improving: Product search system (exact-first FTS)
- Production: NepalIPMS, OCR Engine (inside NepalIPMS)
- Exploring: AI Knowledge Assistant concepts, knowledge systems, human+AI review UI
- Public status labels: /status.html

## Product relationships

- NepalIPMS (https://nepalipms.com) hosts OCR Document Intelligence Engine
- NepalIPMS uses Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2 + FTS search
- OCR implements Document Intelligence + Human+AI Review patterns (/patterns.html)
- Global Law (https://globallaw.com.np) = firm CMS/knowledge; firm also uses NepalIPMS
- ScholarQuest / TopRank / Sri Education / Yogshala = live education & brand platforms
- Compare view: /compare.html
